name: gps-plus-slam-design-system
description: The HUD design system as vanilla HTML + CSS: design.css is what an app vendors, catalog.css is the catalog's own chrome: tokens, atoms, and mock AR screens with real app strings, judged over switchable camera stand-in backgrounds. No build, no framework; open index.html in a browser and iterate. `pnpm run shoot` renders headless screenshots so an agent can see its own edits.
